en: The Way of Maintaining the Family

kurals.tr: Karumam Seyaoruvan Kaidhooven Ennum / Perumaiyin Peetutaiyadhu Il
kurals.m: There is no higher greatness than that of one saying I will not cease in my effort (to raise my family)

kurals.tr: Aalvinaiyum Aandra Arivum Enairantin / Neelvinaiyaal Neelum Kuti
kurals.m: One's family is raised by untiring perseverance in both effort and wise contrivances

kurals.tr: Kutiseyval Ennum Oruvarkuth Theyvam / Matidhatruth Thaanmun Thurum
kurals.m: The Deity will clothe itself and appear before him who resolves on raising his family

kurals.tr: Soozhaamal Thaane Mutiveydhum Thamkutiyaith / Thaazhaadhu Ugnatru Pavarkku
kurals.m: Those who are prompt in their efforts (to better their family) need no deliberation, such efforts will of themselves succeed

kurals.tr: Kutram Ilanaaik Kutiseydhu Vaazhvaanaich / Chutramaach Chutrum Ulaku
kurals.m: People will eagerly seek the friendship of the prosperous soul who has raised his family without foul means

kurals.tr: Nallaanmai Enpadhu Oruvarkuth Thaanpirandha / Illaanmai Aakkik Kolal
kurals.m: A man's true manliness consists in making himself the head and benefactor of his family

kurals.tr: Amarakaththu Vankannar Polath Thamarakaththum / Aatruvaar Metre Porai
kurals.m: Amid his kindred so the burthen rests upon the strong

kurals.tr: Kutiseyvaark Killai Paruvam Matiseydhu / Maanang Karudhak Ketum
kurals.m: As a family suffers by (one's) indolence and false dignity there is to be so season (good or bad) to those who strive to raise their family

kurals.tr: Itumpaikke Kolkalam Kollo Kutumpaththaik / Kutra Maraippaan Utampu
kurals.m: Is it only to suffering that his body is exposed who undertakes to preserve his family from evil ?

kurals.tr: Itukkankaal Kondrita Veezhum Atuththoondrum / Nallaal Ilaadha Kuti
kurals.m: If there are none to prop up and maintain a family (in distress), it will fall at the stroke of the axe of misfortune
